title: Ved Nytaarstid i Nøddebo Præstegaard
summary: "Ved Nytaarstid i Nøddebo Præstegaard" by C. Henrik Scharling is a novel published in 1862. Three brothers—Christopher, Frederik, and Nicolai Kastrup—visit a pastor's home by Roskilde Fjord, where they seek the affections of Pastor Blicher's two daughters, Emmy and Andrea Margrethe. This pastoral idyll became a major success, achieving twelve editions by the century's end and inspiring numerous theatrical adaptations and film versions that became Danish cultural classics.
